title: ApprovalBatchResult
description: `POST /api/v1/agent-harness/approvals/decisions` (G-13, GA-08): one person's decision on calls with the same pattern across runs and sessions, each decided by its run's own decision rule and journaled per call. A batch that mixes patterns, or names a call its run never asked or one decided only on its own card, is refused whole (BATCH_PATTERN_MISMATCH) and decides nothing.

BatchOutcome.description: decided: this request decided it; already_decided: an earlier decision stands (another tab, a retried request); not_decided: it ended or was decided between the check and its turn, with the catalogue code that says why.
